what: Behind the card a pale plate of the same size lies offset .6rem to the bottom right like a shadow, and when hovered the card face sinks onto that plate in .6s expo-out so it overlaps as if pressed — when released it floats back up along the same path. The plate color is set per card as a pale plate of the brand color via --fx-plate

options.--fx-plate: Back panel color (style), default accent color 18% pale panel

use: Card photo · text

from.where: index.html .op-brand__link (four big brand cards — original brand__link::before plate · brand__linkInner translate3d(.6rem,.6rem))
